products.title: EOS C70
products.body_html:
The Canon EOS C70 offers exceptional cinema capabilities in a compact package. Enjoy stunning images with a 4K Super 35mm DGO Sensor and all the built-in features you could ask for, including ND Filters, mini XLRs, direct touch rotatable LCD screen, Dual Pixel CMOS Autofocus, and excellent battery life. Making the EOS C70 even more powerful is compatibility with Canon's expanding line of high-performance RF Lenses.Impresseive Image Quality: Get smooth blacks and bold colours. The EOS C70’s Super 35mm DGO Sensor generates 16+ stops of total dynamic range and maintains low noise levels in order to prioritize saturation for bright areas and lower noise for darker areas.More Built-Ins, Less Add-Ons: Start shooting from day one with all the built-ins you could ask for including ND filters for various lighting conditions, mini XLRs for professional audio recording, and dual SD card slots for simultaneous recording in different formats. Access it all with one hand on the direct touch rotatable LCD screen, allowing for on-the-spot changes while holding the camera.Serious Cinema in a Small Package: Control your dynamic range by choosing between Canon Log 2 or Canon Log 3 Gamma, and capture frame rates up to 120 fps in 4K or up to 180 fps in 2K CROP mode–all with electronic image stabilization. Enhance the EOS C70 further by synchronizing multi-camera productions via the built-in timecode port and adding Cinema RAW Light internal recording, Canon 709 Custom Picture Profile, XF-AVC Intra 4K 60p recording, and other new features via a free firmware upgrade.Super 35mm Dual Gain Output (DGO) Sensor: The EOS C70 features Canon's next generation Super 35mm Dual Gain Output (DGO) Sensor. This sensor is capable of a total dynamic range in excess of 16 stops and includes Canon’s exclusive Dual Pixel CMOS Autofocus technology.DIG!C DV7 Image Processor: The EOS C70 features Canon's DIG!C DV7 image processor that takes the extensive RAW information captured from the imaging sensor and processes it for output. DiG!C is also the engine behind features such as high frame rate recording, Dual Gain Output (DGO) Sensor, Dual Pixel Autofocus, HDR (PQ) output, Electronic Image Stabilization, and proxy recording.Direct Touch Control: The EOS C70 is equipped with Direct Touch Control which allows easy access to commonly used menu settings on the fully-rotatable LCD screen. Users will be able to simply touch the screen to start/stop recording, access file format and resolution, set ISO/Gain, color temperature and iris, and display important settings. Shooting settings that were once in various places of the menu can now be accessed with one hand, allowing for on-the-spot changes while holding the camera.Built-in Mini-XLRS: The EOS C70 is equipped with two mini-XLR audio input terminals for professional audio recording. Additionally, manual audio control dials let users intuitively and quickly adjust the audio control.Built-in Neutral Density Filter System: The thin, motorized ND filter unit has been specifically designed for the RF mount's short flange back. It offers up to 10 stops of ND, allowing users to shoot in various lighting conditions.Dual Pixel CMOS AF: Canon's Dual Pixel CMOS AF technology uses every pixel on the imaging sensor to detect focus and to capture actual image information, offering users high precision focusing and exceptional image quality.EOS iTR AF X: The EOS C70 is the first Cinema EOS camera to feature EOS iTR AF X, which includes a head detection algorithm developed with deep learning technology. In Face Detection mode, the AF works with this advanced algorithm to dramatically improve distance measuring and tracking reliability.Electronic Image Stabilization with Coordinated Control: For the first time in a Cinema EOS camera, enhanced image stabilization is available with coordinated control. With an RF lens and the electronic IS in the EOS C70 , coordinated control optimizes hand-shake correction, resulting in better anti-vibration performance than the conventional EF lens and electronic IS together.

The Canon EOS R3 is designed to satisfy the most demanding expectations in a camera — emphasizing speed, performance, and reliability.

products.title: imageFORMULA DR-M260 Office Document Scanner
products.body_html:
Deliver high-speed, powerful performance to the office with the Canon imageFORMULA DR-M260 document scanner. Its user-friendly design, high-quality image processing, reliable item handling, and robust software offer end-to-end options for capturing business information and improving workplace productivity.WIDE RANGE OF USES: Optimal for workgroups and departments in any industry—especially in the legal, financial, healthcare, and government sectors—the DR-M260 scanner can assist with efficient records management and help reduce paperwork in paper-intensive environments.RELIABLE FEEDING AND POWERFUL PROCESSING: Capable of scanning up to 60 pages per minute*—both sides in a single pass— with the capacity to hold up to 90 sheets in the Automatic Document Feeder (ADF), the DR-M260 scanner can quickly capture and convert paper-based documents into useable digital information. This scanner can reliably handle an assortment of document types, such as thick, thin, even oversized documents and plastic embossed cards. For an added benefit, optional carrier sheets allow passports with IC chips as well as fragile documents to be scanned through the ADF without corrupting the original documents. The DR-M260 scanner is equipped with an onboard image processing CPU, making fast, high-quality scanning possible without depending on PC performance. To help prevent paper jams and damage to documents, paper feeding and eject sensors are incorporated to minimize document mishaps. The scanner also incorporates left and right feeding rollers that revolve independently to help prevent skewed feeding when different size documents are scanned together.EASY-TO-OPERATE DESIGN: The DR-M260 scanner was designed with an accessible Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) panel for user convenience, allowing one to create up to 99 customizable, pre-programmed scan tasks, useful for frequently used scanning modes and output destinations. Scanning status and count can also be reviewed on the LCD panel. For easy maintenance, notifications for errors and roller replacement will appear on the LCD, allowing administrators to tackle any problems before they occur.ROBUST SUITE OF SOFTWARE: The DR-M260 scanner is bundled with a suite of convenient software to help widen the scope of capture and output capabilities. Canon CapturePerfect and Kofax Virtual ReScan (VRS) help to increase the overall quality of documents scanned. Canon CaptureOnTouch V4 can assist with effortless document organization, with files sorted and saved into existing folders as well as automatically creating new folders. In addition, scanned originals can be divided into single files based on bar codes** and counters in addition to blank paper. File names can also be set using text scanned from the document or text that’s already configured. The DR-M260 also includes ISIS/TWAIN drivers, which eases integration with third-party capture or content management systems. These features provide the necessary means for a user to convert business information with ease.HIGH-QUALITY IMAGING: To capture information accurately, the DR-M260 scanner incorporates Canon’s imaging expertise to deliver features such as Character Emphasis to help improve text legibility and Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to create searchable and editable information. Furthermore, to help save time and storage space page sizes and blank pages can be automatically detected.ENVIRONMENT IN MIND: The DR-M260 scanner meets ENERGY STAR® guidelines for energy efficiency and complies with both the EU RoHS and WEEE directives for the reduction of hazardous substances and waste products. The DR-M260 is EPEAT Gold Certified.

products.body_html:
Introducing a standard full-frame camera evolved with hybrid features for still and movie shooting. The EOS R6 Mark II enables various photographic expressions that transcend boundaries between recording personal life and professional production purposes, as well as between photo shooting and movie shooting. Achieve creativity in everyday life with the EOS R6 Mark II.High Image Quality Featuring a New 24.2 Megapixel Full-Frame CMOS Sensor.The EOS R6 Mark II features improved resolution compared to its predecessor. A Canon-developed 35mm full-frame CMOS sensor with approx. 24.2 effective megapixels enables the camera to capture sharp and detailed images, even in low-light scenarios. Regardless of conditions — whether day or night, indoor or outdoor — dark portions of the image, even at high ISO speeds and increased sensitivity, are rendered with low noise.DIGIC X Image ProcessorA powerful DIGIC X Image Processor enables high-performance operation and coordination of processes such as Dual Pixel CMOS AF II, Image Stabilization, image processing, and video functionality. The DIGIC X Image Processor helps ensure your photos and videos look sharp and maintain high-resolution with minimal noise or grain.High-Speed Continuous ShootingFor the first time among full-frame Canon EOS cameras, the EOS R6 Mark II introduces RAW Burst Mode1 at up to 30 fps. By turning on RAW Burst Mode’s pre-shooting, shooting can start slightly before (about 0.5 seconds earlier) the shutter button is fully pressed. Coupled with high-speed continuous shooting at speeds of up to 12 fps with mechanical shutter, and up to 40 fps using electronic (silent) shutter, the camera can capture the split-second details between a subject’s movements.Blazing Fast AutofocusThe highly responsive Dual Pixel CMOS AF II system covers up to approximately 100% x 100% of the picture area, breaking the image into up to 1,053 automatically-selected AF zones during Whole Area AF. The result is outstanding AF coverage, and the compositional freedom to focus sharply on a subject nearly anywhere in the frame.Highly Accurate Subject DetectionDeveloped using Deep Learning Technology, horses, trains, and airplanes are newly detectable, in addition to conventional subjects like people, animals including dogs, cats and birds, and vehicles — cars and motorcycles — especially in a motorsports environment.2,3 For more ease of use, Auto mode is now available, in which the camera automatically selects the type of subject without the need to switch the Subject Detection setting in the menu.

products.title: PowerShot V10
products.body_html:
The PowerShot V10 is a vlog and still camera in a new highly portable form factor with components from the popular G-Series line that lets you create impressive videos on-the-go. With stereo sound capture, a built-in stand, and easy live streaming, this cam is ready to go when you are. Don’t let its size fool you, this is a vlogging studio in a compact package that can be operated with one hand to let you express your story!Small, holdable, and pocketableThe small form factor of this camera makes it incredibly easy to hold and shoot video with. You really have to hold it in your hands to appreciate it. The thing that makes it really usable though is the simple menu systems, one button recording and that the camera powers up almost instantly, so it’s ready to go when you are. Stand right thereThe PowerShot V10 comes with a built-in stand. This incredibly convenient feature allows you to place the camera almost anywhere to get the shots you need. It can lean the camera back or forward with 30 degrees of angle for both. Perfect for looking up at your face from a table, or looking down onto the food you are cooking at the stove. Did you hear that?Sound is just as crucial as video when vlogging, which is why we’ve included two large stereo microphones to capture your voice clearly, and a third microphone to help cancel out unwanted sounds. No messing with lavalier mics clipped to clothing, or big, bulky microphones, with the V10, the whole studio is right in your hand. Seeing the whole pictureWe spent a lot of time perfecting the right lens for this camera. The 19mm (35mm equivalent) lens on the V10 is perfect for getting yourself and anyone else you want into the frame, but more importantly, it’s wide-angle enough that if you are recording yourself, you don’t have to have your arm completely outstretched, so you look more natural, and you can make a video without exhausting your muscles!How do I look?With the 1” CMOS sensor, like those used in the popular PowerShot G series cameras, you are going to look great, even in low light! The built-in subject detection helps to keep your face in focus and well-lit. That is really just the beginning, the V10 also has image stabilization, exposure control, Movie auto level, smooth skin movie mode, a built-in automatic ND-filter, and more!Going sidewaysBy default the PowerShot V10 captures video horizontally, but that isn’t always what you need. Want to go vertical? No problem. Just turn the camera on its side and it will automatically change the aspect ratio to vertical. FiltersWhat is a vlog shoot without some filters? The PowerShot V10 has 14 color filters built-in so you can change the mood and ambiance to fit the scene. There is also one extra filter that is kind of special. It’s an automatic ND Filter (Neutral Density), which helps darken a video without affecting how the colors look. This helps the camera avoid using really fast shutter speeds which can result in unnatural, jerky motion on-screen. It's a still camera too!When you need to capture behind the scenes images, don’t forget that you already have a fully functional still camera in your hand. The high-sensitivity 15.2-megapixel, 1-inch CMOS sensor captures some great images with Auto Photo mode (equivalent to A+ Scene Intelligent Auto).Stream baby streamThe PowerShot V10 has a free companion app – Canon Camera Connect – that lets you communicate with a compatible smartphone via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. Using the app, you can transfer images and videos to share on social media, as well as control the camera remotely and livestream. If you are recording videos to work on later, you can sign up for image.canon so your video footage is automatically uploaded there when the camera is charging and in range of Wi-Fi. Once your videos are uploaded to image.canon, you can have them forwarded to other cloud services like Google Drive or Frame.io. You can even edit the files directly from image.canon in applications like Adobe Premiere. UVC SupportThe PowerShot V10 has UVC (USB Video Class) support built-in, so it can work with any device that supports the UVC standard and can even act as web camera without the need for any additional drivers.HDMI OutSometimes you just want to share on the big screen right away, and you can! The PowerShot V10 has an HDMI micro output port for just such an occasion.

products.title: PZ-E2 Power Zoom Adapter
products.body_html:
The Power Zoom Adapter PZ-E2 enables sophisticated zoom control for the RF24-105mm F2.8 L IS USM Z lens and provides a variety of controllable functions to meet the needs of videographers. The zoom speed of the DC motor can be finely adjusted in a stepless manner via a dial to provide both rapid zoom action and smooth, low-speed zooming. A separate model, the PZ-E2B, is also equipped with a 20-pin port making it compatible with Canon cinema and broadcast lens accessories. Either version attaches directly to the RF24-105mm F2.8 L IS USM Z lens, and draws power from the camera, through contacts on the lens — no batteries are in either PZ-E2 unit. Sophisticated Zoom Control: Power Zoom Adapter PZ-E2 enables smooth, high-precision zoom control during movie shooting. Featuring a DC motor that provides both rapid zoom action and smooth, low-speed zooming, the PZ-E2 allows for unassisted single-person video shooting operation. Zoom Speed Adjustment Dial: Easily control zoom speed via a stepless adjustment dial located at the front of the Power Zoom Adapter. Zoom speed can be finely tuned for precision and operability that satisfies the needs of videographers. Excellent Operability: Easily attach and detach the Power Zoom Adapter PZ-E2 without the use of a special tool*. Simply line up the positioning pins with the sockets on the RF24-105mm F2.8 L IS USM Z lens and turn the mounting screws to fasten the adapter. The placement was designed so it can be attached or detached even while the lens is combined with a rig, gimbal, or tripod so you can keep your production rolling. A thumb rest attachment is also included for additional hand-held comfort. Supports Various Shooting Styles: The Power Zoom Adapter PZ-E2 can be used in various ways depending on the videographer’s shooting style or system configuration. Manual operation of zooming is achieved using the switches on the main unit, camera-side operation is possible via assigning custom buttons**, or remote operation via Canon EOS Utility software or Camera Connect app. Supports PD-E1 Power Adapter: The PD-E1 Power Adapter (sold separately) enables high-speed zoom mode on the Power Zoom Adapter PZ-E2 via the USB type C port, with select EOS camera models. It also lowers the power supply demand on the camera, allowing for longer shoots.

products.title: PowerShot GOLF
products.body_html:
Introducing the PowerShot GOLF Digital Laser Rangefinder from Canon. Able to quickly measure distance and slope to the pin, you’ll now have the tools you need right in the palm of your hand to improve your game. The PowerShot GOLF is small, lightweight and water resistant, making it perfect to easily carry around the course, even in a little sprinkle. Plus, you can take photos and record video to review after the game to keep learning and improving even off the courseOptical Image Stabilization Equipped with Optical Image Stabilization, PowerShot GOLF quickly and clearly helps you lock in on the flag by removing slight hand movements.Slope Correction Technology Knowing the distance to the flag is crucial to hitting your next shot, but it’s not all the information you need. If the hole location is higher or lower than your ball location, you will need to adjust how hard to hit the ball to go the right distance. That is where Slope Correction comes into play. Slope Correction takes elevation to the green into account and provides you with the distance you need to hit your ball to get to the flag. You can turn the Slope Correction on or off during play through the user menu. Turning this feature on will measure your distance and factor in the slope to help you choose the best club for your next shot. While playing in tournaments where slope calculation is prohibited, simply turn the Slope Correction function off and a blue LED light near the front of the rangefinder will illuminate to show that Slope Correction is off.Digital Zoom Most optical rangefinders have only one magnification, but that isn’t always enough power to find the flag. PowerShot GOLF features an electronic viewfinder that has a standard view (6x) and zoomed view (12x) to get you even closer to see the flag and lock onto it.Jolt/Vibrate & Pin Lock PowerShot GOLF has a measurement range of 7 - 800 yards, with an accuracy of +/- 2 yards at maximum distance. PowerShot GOLF also has a flag pin lock function that vibrates the rangefinder when it locks onto the flag.Photo / Video Unlike other rangefinders, PowerShot GOLF also has a photo and video camera built in! Use the camera to record your measurements or turn the laser off and start capturing the moment. Whether it’s an unexpected event on the course, or you want to record your swing to look at later, PowerShot GOLF is ready to go.Size/Weight To get accurate, real-world measurements, you need optics and a laser, and that can take space. Canon has created an extremely compact digital laser rangefinder measuring just 1.2” x 2.3” x 3.6” and weighing just 150g. Small and light enough to throw in your pocket or use with the included belt case.PX4 Equivalent Water Resistant We know a little rain is no deterrent to a golfer, so we made sure it’s not an issue for the PowerShot GOLF too. Get out there when you can, not just when it’s nice!What’s in the Box? Inside you’ll find the PowerShot GOLF Digital Laser Rangefinder plus a carrying case for easy storage.

products.title: EOS R5 Mark II
products.body_html:
Master the Moment The EOS R5 Mark II is an impressive successor to the incredibly versatile EOS R5 camera body, bringing a host of new features and technologies that make this the most powerful EOS 5 series camera ever. It starts with a brand-new Canon manufactured, Full-frame 45MP sensor that is back illuminated and stacked for blazingly fast read-out speeds that allow for up to 30 fps continuous shooting speeds in electronic shutter, then builds on that with major autofocus improvements, increased video capabilities, and so much more.Power. Action. Performance.Totally New Image Sensor Even though the pixel count is the same as the EOS R5 camera body, this is a completely new 45MP sensor design with a redesigned architecture. This new full-frame sensor is stacked and back-illuminated allowing for incredible electronic shutter performance of 30 fps in RAW, JPEG or HEIF format.DIGIC Accelerator The DIGIC Accelerator processor is a completely new front-engine processor, developed by Canon to supplement the powerful DIGIC X image processor. The DIGIC Accelerator handles the processing that makes many of the new features of this camera possible, allowing the DIGIC X image processor to focus solely on image processing. Together they combine for high-precision focusing, with incredible speed at high-image quality.Faster Readout Speed The faster readout speed of the back illuminated and stacked full-frame CMOS image sensor in the EOS R5 Mark II, has reduced the rolling shutter distortion by about 60% compared to the previous EOS R5 camera body. From photos of high-speed moving subjects in sports, to impressive video we’re excited to see what you create with the EOS R5 Mark II.Dual Pixel Intelligent AF Autofocus has been significantly upgraded on the EOS R5 Mark II with features like subject tracking which it shares with the new flagship EOS R1. The new Dual Pixel Intelligent AF subject tracking allows you to maintain focus on a subject even when they are obscured briefly while shooting. And, for even faster positioning of your active AF Area, the EOS R5 Mark II adds Canon’s Eye Control AF - which is even more advanced than the Eye Control in the EOS R3 camera. Once you calibrate the viewfinder to your eye, just look where you want to focus, and the AF Area will move there when you press the AF activation button. This new system is even robust enough for many users to work when the photographer is wearing glasses. Many users will find that this is the fastest and most effortless way to move your autofocus point.Video for Creatives The EOS R5 Mark II has extensive options for the creative imagemaker including resolutions up to DCI 8K, and frame rates up to 23.98p in Full-HD and DCI 2K resolutions. At 4K resolution frame rates up to 119.8p is also possible. These higher frame rate videos will now also support recorded audio for impactful high-speed, or slow-motion video. Powerful Custom Picture options also include Canon Log 2 and Canon Log 3, HLG, PQ, Canon 709 and BT.709 Standard and they are now more customizable through Custom Picture menu including the ability to apply a LUT to your image. The R5 Mark II adds features like a full-size HDMI port to the camera, Waveform monitor, False colour, Focus breathing compensation, and 24-bit LPCM 4-channel audio recording. Users also have the choice of several recording formats including Canon 8K RAW Movie, a new Canon 4K Light RAW Movie format, the new XF-AVC S, and XF-HEVC S, system provides rich audio, flexible filename and metadata options making it even easier to use the EOS R5 Mark II on productions where Cinema EOS cameras like the EOS C70 or EOS C400 may also be used.Packed with Power - Upgrade to Excellence with our New Features High-Speed X High Resolution Image Sensor New 45 Megapixel CMOS Sensor This completely new full-frame stacked, back-illuminated image sensor design allows for incredible electronic shutter imaging performance with high-resolution 45MP images that can be captured at 30fps in full 14bit RAW or C-RAW, 10bit HEIF, or 8bit JPEG formats. Enjoy significantly reduced rolling shutter distortion with the dramatically increased sensor readout speeds and new capabilities like the ability to shoot with Flash when using Electronic Shutter.Versatile Shutter Modes and Drive Speeds The EOS R5 Mark II is equipped with a stacked, back-illuminated image sensor capable of 30fps capture of 14bit RAW imagery in Electronic Shutter. For users that wish for lower than 30fps drive speed, the EOS R5 Mark II offers a wide range of choices for H+, H and L modes. Additionally, through use of Customized buttons, the drive speed can be programmed to increase or decrease the drive speed during shooting by pressing a button. A Mechanical shutter, and Electronic first curtain shutter mode are also available allowing for 12fps continuous shooting for even more versatility. Powerful Continuous and Pre-Continuous Shooting EOS R5 Mark II features up to 30fps continuous shooting speed supporting JPEG, RAW, and HEIF image formats and when Pre-Continuous Shooting is enabled, pressing the shutter button halfway will start the pre-shooting process, when you fully depress the shutter, the previous 1/2 -second of images will be written to the memory card (so up to 20 if you are shooting at 40 fps), and will continue capturing images until you release the shutter button.Sync Speed Priority EOS R5 Mark II now features Sync Speed priority for flash photographers looking for faster flash sync speeds with select Canon Speedlite flashes such as Speedlite 430EX III / 470EX-AI / 600 EX II-RT / EL-100 / EL-1 / EL-5 / EL-10 and Macro Ring Lite MR14-EX II / Macro Twin Lite MT-26EX-RT. With use of these products, in Electronic First Curtain Shutter mode a 1/320th sec. sync speed is possible at full-frame and 1/400th sec. sync speed is possible in 1.6x crop mode. In Electronic Shutter mode, 1/200th sec. sync speed is possible at full-frame resolution, and 1/320th sec. sync speed is possible in 1.6x crop mode. Focus Bracketing with Flash and Depth Compositing The EOS R5 Mark II becomes an even more powerful tool for macro and product photographers looking for immense detail. With a single press of the shutter button, the camera can automatically take a series of photos at different focus distances. The camera then performs depth compositing to generate an image that is clearly in focus from the foreground to background from the source images. This is useful in macro photography where depth of field is often shallow, or where a drop in image quality due to diffraction caused by a narrow aperture is a concern. DIGIC Accelerator The DIGIC Accelerator chip is a completely new processor developed by Canon to supplement the power of the proven DIGIC X processor.Incredible Processing Speed The DIGIC Accelerator processes large volumes of data directly from the image sensor giving you incredible improvements in your imaging performance. Not only does the DIGIC Accelerator provide you with high-speed and highly-accurate AF detection, but it also enables more precise metering calculations using 6144 zone metering – 16x the number of zones as EOS R5 and EOS R3. This means better exposure calculations and improved white balance accuracy for your photos and videos. In-Camera Upscaling The DIGIC Accelerator chip also has a useful in-camera upscaling feature that uses deep learning to double the horizontal and vertical size of a JPEG on your card (leaving the original image untouched) in about 10 seconds. That means you can upscale a 45 Megapixel image to 179 Megapixel right in the camera. Neural Network Noise Reduction In the in-camera RAW processing menu of EOS R5 Mark II the new Neural Network Noise Reduction is now possible allowing for clearer imagery with detail to be produced with greater noise reduction capability to increase your image quality – without the need for a computer, or special software. Blur / Out-of-Focus Image Detection Thanks to the new image sensor, and the addition of the new Accelerated Capture system, the EOS R5 Mark II is capable of capturing up to 30 fps of RAW, JPEG, or HEIF (HDR-PQ) images using Electronic Shutter. With the combination of a high-speed drive frame rate, and the impressive autofocus system in EOS R5 Mark II, the amount of keeper images will be sure to rise. So, when taking JPEG photos of people in Electronic Shutter mode, when the Blur / Out-of-Focus image detection function is enabled, the camera can evaluate and calculate the degree of blur in the detection frame of the main subject, and it adds the result to the EXIF information of the image file. A detection frame and Blur / Out-of-Focus icon is then be displayed during playback to judge the files for the user to speed up culling. It's also possible to customize the playback controls for image jump using the main dial to only see these images "with less blur". This filtering functionality is additionally available in Digital Photo Professional allowing users to cull on their computer." Autofocus Precision Subject Detection and Autofocus The EOS R5 Mark II features an extensive range of detectable subjects for a variety of different situations. With People Detection, the eyes, face, head, upper torso, or full body can all be detected whether it be a portrait of a bride at a wedding, or a soccer player running directly at the goal. When Subject to detect is set to Animal Detection, the eyes, face, or the entire body of cats, dogs, birds, and horses can all be effortlessly tracked so wildlife photography and videography of unpredictable wildlife or pets can be easier. When Vehicle is set in the subject to detect menu, motorsports cars and motorcycles, trains and aircraft can all be detected and an additional spot focusing mode allows the helmet of open race cars, or motorcycle riders to be focused on for additional precision. To make focusing even easier an AUTO subject Detection mode is now available in the EOS R5 Mark II allowing the camera to automatically adjust the Subject Detection mode for you during shooting. Register People Priority With Register People priority enabled, simply by taking a photo of a person, the photographer or videographer can prioritize them as the registered subject when more than one face is detected in a scene. The camera then will tenaciously track these subjects across the scene regardless of when other subjects may be in the frame or even obscuring the subject. Whether you’re photographing your next wedding or doing a video shoot on a gimbal stabilizer for a small business client, with Register People priority the camera will diligently work to prioritize focus on the subjects you want in focus. Action Priority Action priority setting is powered by the Accelerated Capture system. It is a new autofocus setting where in select sports, the camera can analyze and understand more information about the subject movements of players, and automatically move the AF point to a player performing a specific action based on their motion and body movements – such as taking a shot, passing a ball, and so on. With information such as face, head, eye, torso, and joint information of the main subject, and additionally other subjects within the scene at the same time, as well as the ball position information, the camera can tenaciously track the ball carrier, or subjects that are temporarily hidden as they move within the scene or when they make an important action such as shooting the ball. Additionally, the camera can better predict their actions and can recognize where to place the focus to capture moments that were not possible before to help ensure you get the action shot you want when the action is moving incredibly fast in front of you. Soccer, volleyball, and basketball are all supported currently.Advanced Eye Control AF For even faster positioning of your active AF Area, the EOS R5 Mark II adds Canon’s Eye Control AF – which is now even more advanced than the Eye Control AF system found in the EOS R3 camera body. Once you calibrate the viewfinder to your eye, simply look where you want to focus, and only when you press the AF activation button the focus will move to that AF Area position. This new system is even robust enough to work when a user is wearing glasses, and if you operate the camera when wearing sunglasses, it's possible to add additional calibration.Focus Preset EOS R5 Mark II now features Focus Preset, a function that up until now has only been available on Canon super-telephoto lenses. Now preset focus positions can be assigned to any of the camera's buttons, or even the lens L.Fn button and used with all RF lenses that support AF. Even when a subject is not detected as desired, users can register a focus position at a predetermined location to prevent focus from moving to obstacles in the foreground or background. This is ideal for those difficult situations when shooting wildlife or sports where critical focus is imperative in high action situations. Let's Talk Video Video for Creatives The EOS R5 Mark II is built with strong video functionality for the creative imagemaker. This includes 8K 59.94p Canon Light RAW internal recording in 12bit colour and up to 8K 29.97p recording in MP4. In 4K, up to 119.8p with audio is available. At Full HD, and 2K DCI resolutions, frame rates up to 239.8p with audio are also possible. Additionally, a new 4K resolution S RAW format has been added for greater range of tonality at 4K resolutions. “Fine” recording options are also available to record oversampled video, for even greater sharpness and detail. Users now have the choice of several recording formats, EOS R5 Mark II supports 8K Canon RAW Movie, and new to Canon EOS R5 Mark II is the Canon Light RAW format – which is ideal for users seeking the extensive tonal range of RAW, but who are mindful of the storage implications of RAW recording. If 8K resolution is not needed, there’s also now an S-RAW setting for 12-bit 4K RAW movie recording for even greater range of tonality at 4K resolutions. For this user RAW + Proxy recording is supported for convenient post-production workflows. For users who desire to work with MP4 video files, XF-HEVC S, and XF-AVC S are now supported, these formats follow the Cinema EOS file name structure making it even easier to use the EOS R5 Mark II on productions where Cinema EOS cameras like the EOS C70 or EOS C400 may also be used. For these users working with MP4 files, there are now options for XF-AVC S in YCC420 8bit, and YCC422 10bit. In XF-HEVC S, options for YCC420 10bit, and YCC422 10bit are also available. New to EOS R5 Mark II there are now options for Intra recording at High Intra, Standard Intra, Light Intra, as well as Long GOP options in Standard, and Light Long GOP.Powerful Custom Picture Colour Control The EOS R5 Mark II features the Custom Picture menu, unlocking powerful colour control including Canon Log 2 and Canon Log 3 profiles for professionals looking for extensive colour grading flexibility. Canon Log 2 provides up to 16+ stops of exposure latitude for scenes where maximizing dynamic range is a priority. Canon Log 3 retains the original characteristics of Canon Log but with expanded dynamic range. Additional profiles are available for HLG, PQ, Canon 709, and BT.709 Standard for versatility when the imagery needs to be delivered immediately. With all CP files, extensive control over the image is possible including the ability to apply a .cube format LUT in camera.Exposure Aids The EOS R5 Mark II features several exposure monitoring tools such as Zebra display, False Colour and Waveform monitor for accurate exposure control. Zebras are a visual exposure aid that display a specific brightness value with overlay pattern stripes on to the image to aid the camera operator in seeing the exposure value of specific areas of the scene. False colour monitor is another exposure tool that overlays colour to represent specific exposure levels in the scene. Lastly Waveform Monitor is one of the common exposure tools which is used to show the entire image’s luminance in graph form. Pre-Recording for Video Similar to Pre-Continuous shooting in photo mode, EOS R5 provides Pre-recording in video. With this enabled the camera will record either 3-seconds, or 5-seconds before the [REC] button is pressed. This is an ideal safety net for situations where the camera operator absolutely cannot miss the action of the moment. * Note: Pre recording is not available in RAW movie recording, High-frame rate movie, Time-lapse Movie, or HDMI RAW output.Connections for the Creative Featuring a Full-size HDMI-A port, the EOS R5 Mark II is equipped with a professional interface for those that want to use external recorders, capture cards, and even reference displays on their productions. The camera is also equipped with the Canon multi-function shoe – allowing connection to a variety of Canon accessories, including the Tascam CA-XLR2d-C XLR microphone adapter which provides phantom-power capable XLR inputs and access to LPCM 24bit/4CH audio support. Additionally, a USB-C port which supports UVC and UAC for video calls and livestreaming over social media, 3.5mm Microphone, 3.5mm Headphone, PC Sync, and Canon N3 remote port are all available. Longer Recording Times The EOS R5 Mark II is built with great consideration of the recording times needed for today’s creative imagemakers who desire a durable, and dust and water-resistant camera body. The R5 Mark II is built with a magnesium alloy chassis that transfers heat to the body, and a heat-dissipating structure using graphite and aluminum to move heat away from the sensor and card slots. Additionally, there is a setting for control over the Auto power off temperature setting. Allowing the camera operator to choose a higher temperature tolerance where they may want additional recording time but will be directed to use a tripod to prevent discomfort from the high temperature of the body. * When using a new, fully charged LP-E6P.* When using a screen.# When [Movie Servo AF: Disable] and [Movie cropping: Disable] are set. body. Dual Shooting When the moment requires both photo and video recording, photojournalists can now use the Dual Shooting function in the EOS R5 Mark II. Using the SD card slot 7680x4320 resolution 8K JPEG images can be captured to card slot 2, while the CFexpress card records Full-HD video at up-to 59.94p to the main card with no interruption to the video. EOS VR Support The EOS R5 Mark II camera body is fully compatible with the RF5.2mm F2.8 L Dual Fisheye lens enabling high-resolution Stereoscopic 3D 180° VR content creation captured to a single image sensor. When equipped with the RF5.2mm F2.8 L Dual Fisheye lens, the EOS R5 Mark II can record up to DCI 8K imagery at up to 59.94p in Canon Light RAW Movie format. Perspective projection transformation can now be performed in video playback, and the viewpoint can be viewed across the scene, and magnified by use of the multi-controller or touch operation, enabling more efficiency. Also new to the EOS R5 Mark II is the inclusion of additional metadata to improve both the speed and the effectiveness of the digital stabilization provided in the EOS VR Utility application to deliver more stable footage for faster editing.Improved Image Stabilization *1 *2 *3 The EOS R5 Mark II has three stabilization methods (In-body, optical, and movie digital IS) for impressive video stabilization performance, where it can help suppress blur in the peripheral areas. It's even possible to use the In-body stabilizer to automatically level your image. Hardware Powerhouse Dual Card Slots for CFexpress and UHS-II SD Memory Cards Whether you are shooting photos every day, or are recording high resolution videos, the EOS R5 Mark II camera can capture an incredible number of images through its high-speed CFexpress Type B, and UHS-II SD card slot. The two card slots can also be utilized for separate recording of still photos and movies, main and proxy recording of movies, and recording to multiple cards. Bright and Clear Viewfinder The new Electronic viewfinder in the EOS R5 Mark II is the same 0.5-inch 5.76 million dot OLED EVF you can find on the EOS R3 with approx. 100% coverage, 0.76x magnification, and an eyepoint of approx. 24mm.Powerful Battery With all the enhancements, EOS R5 Mark II requires a little more power than previous EOS Mirrorless cameras, and therefore it ships with a new, higher amperage battery, the LP-E6P. It is the same size and shape as previous LP-E6-series batteries but is easily distinguished from older models by featuring a white stripe and white Canon logo. This new battery can be used in older Canon mirrorless and even DSLR cameras but will require a camera firmware update to do so. Canon LP-E6N and LP-E6NH battery packs can be used in the R5 Mark II camera, but with some significant limitations – especially Wi-Fi connection, and for video recording. Continuous Drive speeds with mechanical or first-curtain electronic shutter will be reduced. This applies to any battery in any of the optional battery grips as well. Wireless Connectivity for the Everyday The EOS R5 Mark II was built with the same extensive networking capability as the EOS R1 camera to provide communication capability for the most demanding professional photojournalists and networking specialists however, most photographers are not networking experts, so for these customers the EOS R5 Mark II provides powerful connectivity that is made simple and convenient including the ability to use Wi-Fi and Bluetooth to connect to a smartphone or tablet to download photos and videos, or to control the camera through the Canon Camera Connect App. Tethered shooting support is additionally available to transfer files into a computer through the EOS Utility application. There is even the ability to upload to photos and videos to image.canon cloud service for auto forward support of Adobe Creative Cloud for Photoshop, Lightroom, and Frame.io users, as well as Flickr, Google Photos and even Google Drive accounts. Wireless for the Professional Imagemaker The EOS R5 Mark II networking functions are created with the support of the same functionality as the EOS R1 camera body to support professional imagemakers needing to deliver imagery to the reader as fast and as reliably as possible. It provides extensive networking speed and functionality including the support of 6 GHz, 5 GHz, and 2.4GHz bands, as well as MIMO technology (Multiple-input and multiple-output) to improve communication quality by incorporating multiple antennas, which is the first time it has been implemented as a built-in Wi-Fi function in a Canon camera. Going Beyond Gigabit Speed with Ethernet Connectivity Since many professional photographers work in wired network environments, the EOS R5 Mark II supports faster communication speed than was previously possible with previous cameras equipped with 1000BASE-T interfaces (1Gbps maximum theoretical value). When using the optional BG-R20EP or CF-E20EP Ethernet equipped grips, the new 2.5BASE-T IEEE802.3bz wired LAN interface supports communication at up to 2.5Gbps (maximum theoretical value) using a UTP RJ45 cable such as CAT5e or CAT6 cable.Pro Wireless Functions and Security Support Today's cameras used by photojournalists need to evolve with the capabilities of the network environment around the photographer, these imagemakers are often running around arenas, and stadiums and require high-speed and reliable connections, so the EOS R5 Mark II now supports the same automatic switching of access points as the EOS R5 Mark II, when the SSID of the same name, password, authentication and encryption in another location has a stronger radio signal than the camera is already connected to during FTP transfer. The camera supports FTP Multi-thread for two FTP connections established from the camera to an FTP server allowing for multiple files to be simultaneously transferred using each of the connections. Also, when using the optional BG-R20EP, or CF-R20EP grip with the EOS R5 Mark II it will automatically switch to wireless LAN if the wired LAN cable is disconnected during use, and it will switch to wired LAN automatically if a wired LAN cable is connected during wireless use. The camera supports higher level security including WPA-3-Enterprise 192-bit encryption algorithm strength, Enhanced Open by using the Opportunistic Wireless Encryption (OWE) encryption method. Proven Durability The EOS R5 Mark II builds on the legacy of the durable EOS 5-series that is trusted by critically demanding customers worldwide. It features a magnesium alloy chassis that is built to provide outstanding strength, robustness, heat dissipation with a light weight. The new EVF features a sealed structure, resisting environmental changes making it difficult to fog up, with anti-fog performance superior to even the EOS R3. Additionally, with a dust and water-resistant design it will provide confidence in harsh conditions, even when using one of the new optional grips which all feature the same level of sealing as the body. Versatile Grips The EOS R5 Mark II has three optional grips that provide additional battery power and exciting new functionality. Battery Grip BG-R20 Allows for two LP-E6-series batteries and provides controls for vertical shooting, including an improved multi-controller position. The weight balance has been optimized for shooting vertically or with heavier large-aperture lenses. Battery Grip BG-R20EP Allows for two LP-E6-series batteries, provides vertical shooting controls, and includes a 2.5G Base-T high-speed ethernet port for fast-paced tethered shooting. products.title: EOS C80
products.body_html:
The EOS C80 camera is designed for limitless creative vision. The compact, full-featured camera body includes Canon's 6K full frame Back-Illuminated Stacked CMOS sensor, Cinema RAW Light and 4K/120p internal recording, Canon’s next-generation Dual Pixel CMOS AF II and a 12G-SDI interface. The EOS C80 seamlessly integrates into almost any production providing the ultimate flexibility and outstanding image quality.6K Full Frame Back-illuminated Stacked CMOS Sensor The EOS C80 features our 6K back-illuminated stacked full frame CMOS sensor. The sensor offers exceptional low noise, enabling the camera to excel in a wide variety of lighting situations and maximizing the camera’s full dynamic range. The new sensor delivers faster read-out speeds than previous EOS sensors and when compared to a front-illuminated CMOS sensor, the new sensor’s architecture provides improved sensitivity as it increases light capturing efficiency and improves 4K image quality with 6K oversamplingi. Triple Base ISO (800, 3200 and 12,800) Our full frame 6K back-illuminated stacked sensor offers triple-base ISO, which allows the EOS C80 to deliver stunning imagery in a wide range of lighting conditions. With base ISOs of 800, 3200, and 12,800, you will be able to maximize the full dynamic range of the sensor in brilliantly lit or low-light shooting conditions.Available ISO range (When using Canon Log 2/Log 3, RAW)Internal Recording: 6K 30P Cinema RAW Light, XF-AVC, XF-HEVC S and XF-AVC S The EOS C80 can record up to 6K 30P in Cinema RAW Light. Other recording options include our standard XF-AVC codec which can record in 10-bit 4:2:2 with oversampling from the 6K sensor, creating rich detail and smooth imagery, at frame rates up to 120P, without the need for cropping the image from the sensor. For slow or fast motion recording, the EOS C80 can support up to 4K 120P and 2K 180. Two additional recording codecs are now available: XF-AVC S and XF-HEVC S. These formats feature an easy-to-manage naming system and folder structure, while recording in the familiar MP4 format and preserving metadata. Additionally, the EOS C80 also supports 6K/60P HDMI RAW output.Note: When frame rate exceeds 100P in Super 35mm mode, the angle of view is cropped at approx. 6%.Note: When frame rate exceeds 100P in Super 35mm mode, the angle of view is cropped at approx. 6%.High-frame Rate Recording With Auto Focus and Subject Detection When recording in slow and fast motion (Slow & Fast, 4:2:2 10-bit), the EOS C80 enables Dual Pixel AF II for frame rates of 100 and 120fps and Subject Detection for frame rates between 72-120fps. Dual SD Card Slots The EOS C80 features two SD Card slots supporting simultaneous recordingii and a variety of recording modes, such as simultaneous recording for backup or proxy files for editing, simultaneous recording of different formats and resolutions, and relay recording, which is critical for lengthy video shoots. The slots are compatible with SD UHS-II, V90-class cards. Dual Slot Recording Simultaneous recording of proxy files Simultaneous recording of different formats Relay recording Camera-to-Cloud Collaboration With the release of the December 2024 firmware, the camera will have native compatibility with Frame.io’s Camera-to-Cloud (C2C) technology. This addition will enable you to send proxy files while recording internally, directly from the camera, for a faster and more secure path from production to post. The efficient proxy files don’t require additional processing or conversion, and are available to view, share, and edit remotely between teams in different locations.Dual Pixel CMOS AF II The EOS C80 supports the next generation of Canon’s acclaimed Dual Pixel CMOS Autofocus, Dual Pixel CMOS AF II. The camera’s back-illuminated stacked sensor provides better light-capturing efficiency, widening the area of the sensor that can be used for AF.EOS iTR AF X (People Detection) With outstanding speed, precision, and a wide autofocus range, Dual Pixel CMOS AF II uses the EOS Intelligent Tracking and Recognition (iTR AF X) algorithm, developed with deep learning technology, to enable high-performance detection of human beings. In addition to human eyes, face, and head, the camera can detect a human body and follow it with high accuracy.EOS iTR AF X (Animal Detection) iTR AF X Animal Detection detects the eyes, face, or the entire body of an animal to enable highly accurate focusing and tracking not affected by subject size or face orientation.iii 12G-SDI and a Variety of Interfaces The EOS C80 has a diverse set of interfaces making it a versatile camera for variety of productions. The EOS C80 distinguishes itself with built-in 12G or 3G SDI and a second full-sized BNC output for Time Code, which enable uncompressed video signal transfer with a secure cable connection. Other interfaces include: two three-pin mini-XLR audio inputs (INPUT 1 and INPUT 2), a Microphone terminal (3.5mm stereo mini-jack), and REMOTE terminal (2.5mm stereo mini-mini), a full-size HDMI interface (HDMI OUT, Type A Terminal). With the December 2024 firmware upgrade, the EOS C80 gains a 1920x1080P output option while recording internally at higher resolutions. SDI OUT Terminal (BNC) Input 1 Terminal (3-pin Mini XLR) Input 2 Terminal (3-pin Mini XLR) Microphone Terminal USB Type-C Terminal Headphone Terminal Remote Terminal HDMI Output Terminal (Type-A) A. Internal Wi-Fi B. Time Code Terminal (BNC) C. Multi-function Shoe Terminal D. Ethernet TerminalEthernet, and Wi-Fi Control The built-in Ethernet port and Wi-Fi enable Canon's IP-based remote control XC Protocol. XC Protocol maximizes operability and remote control of camera settings. Using the XC Protocol, the camera can be operated by Canon’s RC-IP1000 and RC-IP100 controllers (sold separately), and XC Protocol-enabled third-party remote control panels (RCP) can remotely shade the camera. Additionally, Canon’s Remote Control Camera Application (RCCA) can control camera settings as well as multiple cameras. The camera also features SRT protocol, enabling IP streaming of video and audio. internally at higher resolutions.Built-in ND Filters, Improved Body Design, Compact and Lightweight The EOS C80’s compact mechanical ND filter assembly is specifically designed for the RF mount's short flange back. Buttons for direct control of ND filters are located on the right-hand side of the camera. The EOS C80 provides up to ten stops of ND filtration, allowing users to shoot in various lighting conditions. The use of ND filters allows a camera operator to adjust exposure while maintaining the depth of field.The RF mount’s short flange back allows the EOS C80’s body to be small and lightweight, making the camera just as comfortable on a drone or a gimbal as it is on your shoulder, a tripod, or any configuration where compact size and light weight are important.1. LCD Panel with Higher Luminance 2. Panel Lock Mechanism 3. The newly-designed joystick controller provides easier control and menu navigation4. Quarter-inch baseplate mounting hole under the front of the EOS C80 adds more options for securing and positioning the camera in a variety of shooting situationsThe camera also has an ergonomic design with a new, lightweight handle assembly, and the Multi-function Shoe is located just above the LCD screen.Mount Adapter PL-RF with Cooke/i Technology Compatibility The Mount Adapter PL-RF, new to the RF ecosystem, unlocks a broad assortment of PL mount lenses for Canon’s RF cameras. The adapter is compatible with Cooke/i Technology’s metadata protocol and includes lock plates to ensure a secure lens mount. The December 2024 firmware update adds compatibility with the new RF70-200mm F2.8 L IS USM Z zoom lens and the RF24mm F1.4 L VCM and RF50mm F1.4 L VCM hybrid lensesAuto Clear Scan Mode The Auto Clear Scan setting available in the EOS C80, is an automatic shutter mode setting that can detect the frequency of light sources between 50.0 Hz to 2011.2 Hz to help reduce or virtually eliminate the flickering in some LED walls.Canon Multi-Camera Control App The EOS C80 is compatible with the Canon Multi-Camera Control App for iPhone or iPad. This app empowers camera operators to have control over recording start and stop, focus, zoom and iris, ND Filters, ISO, Shutter, White Balance, Custom Picture and more, all while viewing the image from the camera.Remote Control Camera Application The EOS C80’s built-in Ethernet and Wi-Fi connectivity enables centralized control via the Remote Camera Control Application (RCCA). RCCA provides simultaneous camera control for up to nine cameras with video - achieving a "multi-camera operation". At a video production or broadcasting site, an operator can select a camera from the videos displayed on the "Connected Camera List", within the application and operate it from the "Camera Control Area" in the control panel of the software. The software is included and can be installed immediately without having to prepare a hardware controller in advance making it easy to use for the operator while creating an effective one-person

products.body_html:
The RF10-20mm F4 L IS STM is a unique ultra-wide-angle lens that gives you corrected, rectilinear coverage to an incredible 10mm with full-frame cameras. Great for still photography and videography, the 10mm ultra-wide-angle effect is outstanding for its dramatic look, lending visual drama to your landscape, interior, architecture, travel, and even photojournalism images. This lens features true L-Series quality with optical and digital corrections for distortion, and optical image stabilization (OIS) for better low-light performance, especially when shooting video. Autofocus is handled by a tried-and-true STM-type focus motor which actually allows the overall lens design to be more compact while still providing rapid AF and smooth focusing during video recording.In addition, this lens can achieve image stabilization correction of 6.0 CIPA standard stops* with coordinated IS. The front lens element is coated in Fluorine for added durability, so you can easily wipe away oils and fingerprints. Canon SSC (Super Spectra Coating, and advanced ASC (Air Sphere Coating) and SWC (Subwavelength Structure Coating) technologies to help reduce flare, ghosting and other aberrations. The optical quality of this lens is impressive with 16 elements in 12 groups, including one super UD element, three UD glass elements, and three aspheric elements. This lens also has a minimum focus distance of just under 10 inches at all focal lengths.Modern Design:The design of this lens is geared toward getting the job done efficiently with light weight, fast focusing, image stabilization, and a programmable control ring. There is even a petal-type lens hood built right into the barrel of the lens.Incredible Dimensions:Capturing images at 10mm is already pretty special, but to do it in a lens that is lighter and smaller than even our own EF11-24mm f/4 L USM is quite a feat. The RF mount design allows for the possibility of this wider-angle lens range and is also a key factor in the size and weight reduction of the lens. This also enables the addition of IS (image stabilization) in a lens that otherwise might not be able to have it.Excellent Image Quality:Again, thanks to the Canon RF lens mount, the RF10-20mm F4 L IS STM lens offers great optical quality. Its optical design includes one super UD element, three UD elements and three aspheric elements (including large-diameter aspheric and UD aspheric elements) as well as Subwavelength structure coating (SWC) and Air Sphere Coating (ASC) to reduce ghosting. On top of that, this lens features the same dust- and water- resistance found on L-series lenses with seals around the Control ring, focus ring, zoom ring, operation panel, and lens mount.Make Some Movies:The RF10-20mm F4 L IS STM lens has a lot of advantages and features when it comes to video. First, you can take full advantage of the 10mm focal length on full-frame cameras, and you can even shoot 4K 60p without crop mode. If you are shooting on an APS-C camera, you’ll have access to wider angles than you ever have before (coverage equivalent to a 16-32mm lens). Another video advantage is the fixed f/4 aperture, minimizing exposure changes while zooming. Optical Image Stabilization - Up to 5.0 stops¹ of Shake Correction :For consistently sharp results, the RF10-20mm F4 L IS STM features built-in optical Image Stabilization, providing enhanced shake reduction for up to 5.0 stops¹ of shake correction. When paired with an EOS R-series camera that has In-Body Image Stabilization (IBIS), the Coordinated IS allows for up to 6.0 stops² of correction. Steady hand-held video, and incredibly sharp still images, are the benefits of this new RF ultra-wide-angle lens. High-speed, Smooth and Quiet Autofocus:With any Canon EOS R-series camera, expect swift and positive autofocus. The STM leadscrew-type focus drive system is especially beneficial to video users, because of its combination of quiet operation and outstanding smoothness of focus changes during actual recording. And AF during still shooting is quick and equally quiet.Get Close:With a minimum focus distance of just under 10 inches you can capture some really incredible ultra-wide-angle close-ups for a look unlike anything else.

products.title: EOS C400
products.body_html:
Innovation, versatility and imaging excellence all merge in the new EOS C400, the full-frame, RF-mount cinema camera tailored for boundless creativity. The compact camera body is well-appointed and includes Canon's newly-developed 6K full-frame Back-Illuminated Stacked CMOS sensor, which supports a variety of sensor modes, including Full Frame 3:2, Super 35mm, and Super 16mm. The EOS C400 features 6K/60p Cinema RAW Light and 4K/120p internal recording along with Canon’s next-generation Dual Pixel CMOS AF II, among other outstanding features. Additionally, the EOS C400 has a variety of interfaces, including return input, Ethernet, and Wi-Fi, enabling control from various Canon and third-party devices. The EOS C400 is the ideal fusion of both functionality and form, and seamlessly integrates into almost any production with its robust and compact design.Features6K Full-Frame Back-illuminated Stacked CMOS Sensor The EOS C400 is the first Cinema EOS camera to feature the newly-developed, 6K back-illuminated stacked full-frame CMOS sensor, which offers exceptionally low noise. The sensor delivers faster read-out speeds than previous EOS sensors and when compared to a front-illuminated CMOS sensor, the sensor’s architecture provides improved sensitivity as it increases light capturing efficiency and improves 4K image quality with 6K oversampling2.Full Frame 3:2 “Open Gate” Sensor Mode By selecting Full Frame 3:2 from the Sensor Mode section of the main menu, you can shoot using the full area of the sensor and then use that information in post to crop and re-frame your footage to the aspect ratio of your choice. This is especially valuable when shooting with full-frame anamorphic lenses.Super 35mm3 and Super 16 Crop Modes The EOS C400 camera’s Full-Frame sensor is capable of capturing footage in both 17:9 and 16:9 formats, and supports the use of Super 35mm and Super 16mm lenses with the appropriate sensor crop modes.Anamorphic De-Squeeze Anamorphic lenses have an elongated rear element that makes it possible to utilize flare and bokeh effects that cannot be achieved with ordinary lenses. The EOS C400 provides desqueeze magnification options, including OFF/2x/1.8x/1.5x/1.3x.Triple-Base ISO (800, 3200, and 12,800) Our newly-developed, full-frame 6K back-illuminated stacked sensor offers triple-base ISO, which allows the EOS C400 to deliver stunning imagery in a wide range of lighting conditions. With base ISOs of 800, 3200, and 12,800, you will be able to maximize the full dynamic range of the sensor in brilliantly lit or low-light shooting conditions. Internal Cinema RAW Light, XF-AVC Recording and New XF-HEVC S, XF-AVC S Formats The EOS C400 can record up to 6K 60P Cinema RAW Light with an additional three Cinema RAW Light recording modes, HQ, ST and LT also with 12-bit recording. Other recording options include our standard XF-AVC codec which can record in 10-bit 4:2:2 with oversampling from the 6K sensor, creating rich detail and smooth imagery, at frame rates up to 120P, without the need for cropping the image from the sensor. For slow or fast motion recording, the C400 can support up to 4K 120P and 2K 180P. Additionally, the C400 has two new recording codecs, XF-AVC S and XF-HEVC S. These formats feature an easy-to-manage naming system and folder structure, while recording in the familiar MP4 format and preserving metadata. Distortion and Chromatic Aberration Correction During RAW Playback The C400's July 2025 firmware release will support Distortion and Chromatic Aberration correction while playing back Cinema RAW Light clips on camera. This ensures productions can accurately review takes on-set without needing to offload the card to a computer first. Camera-to-Cloud Collaboration The camera has native compatibility with Frame.io’s Camera-to-Cloud (C2C) technology. This feature enables you to send proxy files immediately after recording internally, directly from the camera, for a faster and more secure path from production to post. The efficient proxy files don’t require additional processing or conversion, and are available to view, share, and edit remotely between teams in different locations. CFexpress Type B and SD Cards Slots CFexpress and SD card slots on the EOS C400 allow for simultaneous recording even when shooting RAW. All recording options are recorded to the camera’s CFexpress slot with sub-recording and proxy options available on the SD card slot. CFexpress (Type-B)SD USH-IIRecord Various RAW Types to a CFexpress Card Cinema RAW Light High Quality: RAW HQ Standard Quality: RAW ST Light Recording: RAW LT Record Various RAW Types to a CFexpress Card XF-AVC XF-HEVC S (H.265 / HEVC) XF-AVC S (H.264 / AVC) Proxy (XF-AVC / XF-HEVC S / XF-AVC S) Built-in Mechanical ND Filters The C400’s compact mechanical ND filter assembly is specifically designed for the RF mount's short flange back. Buttons for direct control of ND filters are located on the right-hand side of the camera. The C400 provides up to ten stops of ND filtration, allowing users to shoot in various lighting conditions. The use of ND filters allows a camera operator to adjust exposure while maintaining the depth of field.Improved Autofocus with Dual Pixel CMOS AF II4 The C400 supports the next generation of Canon’s acclaimed Dual Pixel CMOS Autofocus, Dual Pixel CMOS AF II. The back-illuminated stacked sensor provides better light-capturing efficiency, widening the area of the sensor that can be used for AF. Additionally, you can utilize AF while recording in slow or fast motion at speeds up to 4K 120P.EOS Intelligent Tracking and Recognition With outstanding speed, precision, and wide AF range, Dual Pixel CMOS AF II uses the EOS Intelligent Tracking and Recognition (iTR AF X) algorithm, developed with deep learning technology, to enable high-performance subject detection. In addition to human eyes, face, and head, the camera can now detect the body of a person and follow them with high accuracy.EOS Intelligent Tracking and Recognition With outstanding speed, precision, and wide AF range, Dual Pixel CMOS AF II uses the EOS Intelligent Tracking and Recognition (iTR AF X) algorithm, developed with deep learning technology, to enable high-performance subject detection. In addition to human eyes, face, and head, the camera can now detect the body of a person and follow them with high accuracy. The adapter is compatible with Cooke/i Technology’s metadata protocol which enables real-time output of lens metadata (focus/zoom/iris position, and other data in addition to lens model information). Additionally, the robust adapter features locking plates that attach to the camera with four screws for a secure and stable lens mount.Variety of Interfaces, Including Timecode and Genlock The C400 has a diverse set of interfaces making it a versatile camera for film set and live broadcast productions. A dedicated 12-pin LENS terminal for broadcast and cine-servo lenses, 12G-SDI (SDI OUT) and 3G-SDI (MON.) for monitor outputs, two mini-XLR audio inputs (INPUT 1 and INPUT 2), DIN connectors for Time Code (TC), Genlock and return video (G-LOCK/SYNC/RET), a full-size HDMI (HDMI OUT), built-in Wi-Fi, Ethernet and REMOTE terminal. The December 2024 firmware upgrade adds a 1920x1080P output option for monitoring while recording at higher resolutions. Return Video Input, Ethernet, and Wi-Fi Control The versatile C400 has specialized functions for live productions including a return video input that notifies operators which camera is currently being broadcast live. The built-in Ethernet port enables Canon's IP-based remote control XC Protocol. XC Protocol helps to maximize operability and remote control of camera settings. Using the XC Protocol, the camera can be operated by Canon’s RC-IP1000 and RC-IP100 controllers, and XC Protocol-enabled third-party remote control panels (RCP) can remotely shade the camera. Additionally, Canon’s Remote Control Camera Application (RCCA) can control camera settings as well as multiple cameras. The camera also features SRT protocol, enabling IP streaming of video and audio.Compact, Lightweight, Ergonomic Body Design The RF mount’s short flange back allows the EOS C400 body to be small and lightweight making the camera just as comfortable on a drone or a gimbal as it is on your shoulder, a tripod, or any configuration where compact size and light weight are important.New LCD, Handle and Grip Design The EOS C400 ships with a variety of beneficial accessories including a new LCD touch-screen monitor, camera grip and battery pack. A new handle assembly with captive screws and Multi-function Shoe6 has been designed for the EOS C400. The new LCD attachment allows the camera operator to adjust the angle and distance of the LCD monitor to suit almost any shooting style including handheld and shoulder-mounted. The LCD monitor also employs the MC-5U, a USB-C cable connecting to the camera body.The EOS C400 also has an ergonomic camera grip for operator comfort, with three additional assignable buttons. The grip can be articulated to achieve a range of shooting angles.Enhanced Level 2 Display The Peripheral Border Display, also known as Display Level 2, will be enhanced to show Sensor Mode and Resolution, Recording Codec selected for each card slot, Custom Picture Gamma and color space, Digital Image Stabilization status, and the tilt and roll degrees of the electronic level.Assignable Buttons The December 2024 firmware update adds an enhancement to our 60 to 24p pulldown feature, designed with Houses of Worship in mind, that maintains exposure when changing frame rates with an assignable button. The EOS C400 update will also include camera/media switching via an assignable button.Auto Clear Scan Mode The Auto Clear Scan setting available in the camera is an automatic shutter mode setting that can detect the frequency of light sources between 50.0 Hz to 2011.2 Hz to help reduce or virtually eliminate the flickering in some LED walls.Additional Features in June 2026 Firmware Update The June 2026 firmware update introduces new USB control protocols that allow for gimbal operation of REC start/stop, Iris, Shutter, ISO, and Focus functions. Furthermore, the inclusion of view assist during playback ensures accurate color and exposure evaluation and SRT auto-reconnect improves livestreaming stability should the connection be lost.Canon Multi-Camera Control App The EOS C400 is compatible with the Canon Multi-Camera Control App for iPhone or iPad. This app empowers camera operators to have control over recording start and stop, focus, zoom and iris, ND Filters, ISO, Shutter, White Balance, Custom Picture and more, all while viewing the image from the camera.

products.title: PowerShot V1
products.body_html:
Welcome to the PowerShot V1, a powerful video-first camera with all the features you are looking for with content creation, in an all-in-one design. This new sleek design features an ultra-wide-angle zoom lens, advanced autofocus, a built-in cooling fan, and impressive stabilization. The PowerShot V1 will let you focus on your creativity without worrying about time limits getting in the way of your videos.FeaturesThe LensThe PowerShot V1 is equipped with an ultra-wide-angle zoom lens that is equivalent to a 17-52mm lens for Full Frame cameras (16-50mm when taking still photos) with an aperture range of F2.8-11 at the wide-angle setting, making it ideal for vlogging without the worry about changing lenses. A built-in 3-stop ND filter is available, for bright outdoor lighting conditions, so you are ready to shoot, wherever you are.Get Up CloseCapture subjects in large detail by focusing down to 5.9 inches. This enables richly expressive close-up shots using the wide angle of view and bokeh that a wide-angle lens can provide.The SensorLarger than the sensors typically found on compact cameras, the newly designed 1.4-type CMOS sensor, has 22.3 megapixels for still images (18.7 megapixels for video), giving you enhanced image quality which provides a shallower depth of field, better light performance, improved Dynamic Range and greater ISO performance.Keeping it CoolThe PowerShot V1 features a cooling fan to keep internal components from getting too hot, allowing for unlimited continuous shooting at 4K60P. The fan pulls heat from the sensor and vents it out the side to prevent overheating, which extends recording times and ensures consistency during long shoots.VideoThis camera is focused on the video content creator, and it shows with oversampled and uncropped options for both 1080 and 4K30 for enhanced sharpness and detail. It also offers cropped 4K60, providing clarity and smoothness of 4K resolution at 60fps, with an approximate crop factor of 1.4x. For more advanced users, the PowerShot V1 also has Canon Log 3, allowing you to record movies with a wide dynamic range and 10-bit colour depth, starting at a base speed of ISO 800.Shooting ModesSince this camera was created around the idea of capturing video, it comes with some unique features that enhance your creations. Let’s start with a close-up movie mode for displaying small objects (which the dual pixel AF II will lock onto). Of course you also have Movie IS to reduce camera shake for clear videos, and Smooth Skin Movie. You can also use the standard choices of full-auto, full manual operation, and Shutter- or Aperture-priority exposure. On top of all of this, you can even register up to 3 custom shooting modes (C1, C2, C3) for video or still shooting. In a first for PowerShot cameras, the V1 includes a switch for video or still shooting, allowing you access to all shooting modes on the mode dial.Keep it SteadyYour videos will look even more professional with both lens optical IS and Movie digital IS functions from our EOS mirrorless cameras, working separately or together to provide fantastic image stabilization. Even if you're walking while shooting, your footage will look natural and steady. We’ve also introduced Subject Tracking Image Stabilization, which prioritizes stabilization at the subject’s location when it’s off-center. * Using Movie digital IS results in cropped movies. ** Movie Electronic IS, Subject Tracking IS, and Movie Auto Horizontal Compensation are not available at 4K crop 60p, at beautiful skin video.Selfie ServiceChances are that you will be capturing a lot of yourself, so we have included features to make that experience even better, like a flip out LCD so you can see yourself in front of the camera. A tally light has been added to the front of the camera so you know when it is recording. Even the grip has been redesigned to be better held from the front utilizing your thumb for stability and to control the tilt. Everything you need to make yourself look great!The Right ConnectionsThis camera also offers fabulous connectivity so that you can capture and share your creative endeavors effortlessly. With Bluetooth you can connect to your smartphone to use it as a wireless remote control for capturing images even in continuous shooting modes. The PowerShot V1 also supports Full HD streaming over USB and wireless LAN, perfect for video calls or live streaming. The Canon Camera Connect app let’s you access, view, and share your photos and videos when you are on-the-go. Additionally enjoy high-quality audio with its three built-in microphone array (which also helps to reduce background noise) and included windscreen as well as a mic jack, and a headphone jack for connecting external devices. Lastly with the multi-function hot-shoe, you can add additional compatible accessories as they come out, and even now support multi-function accessories like the DM-E1D digital microphone, and the AD-P1 Smartphone adapter to easily transfer photos and videos.Live Switcher MobileJust install the app and connect your smartphone wirelessly, and you can live stream while switching between up to three cameras. Switching between screens helps you keep your viewers engaged. You can show the best angles that work for you. Simple to use, this app allows you to switch smoothly even when solo streaming.
